source_excerpt: Ayushmann Khurrana's 'Udta Teer' recorded a domestic net collection of Rs 2.65 crore on Wednesday, October 28. The film's worldwide gross has nearly hit the Rs 50 crore mark, with the total collections reaching an estimated Rs 42.68 crore after six days in theatres. Its India net collection stands at Rs 28.65 crore, while the domestic gross has climbed to Rs 34.18 crore. Overseas earnings contributed Rs 75 lakhs on Wednesday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 8.50 crore.According to Sacnilk, Wednesday's domestic collection declined by 18.5% compared with Tuesday's Rs 3.25 crore. The film played across 5,781 shows nationwide during the day. It sold 152,148 tickets on Wednesday, taking its total reported footfall to 1,466,612.'Udta Teer' witnesses a weekday slowdownThe spy comedy enjoyed stronger business over its opening weekend before experiencing a decline on Monday. Collections increased from Friday to Sunday, with the film recording its highest daily earnings on October 25. Monday brought a sharp correction, followed by a modest improvement on Tuesday.The film's occupancy also reflected the changing audience response. Sunday recorded the strongest overall occupancy in its first six days, while Wednesday's nationwide figure in the daily summary stood at 12%. The film's latest performance comes as it nears the end of its first week in cinemas.Wednesday's Hindi 2D occupancyThe Hindi 2D version of 'Udta Teer' recorded an overall occupancy of 10.74% on Wednesday. Morning shows registered 5.69% occupancy while afternoon screenings reached 10.62%. Evening shows performed better, with occupancy rising to 13.85%.The session-wise figures show that attendance improved later in the day. However, the overall occupancy remained modest, reflecting the film's weekday slowdown.Ayushmann Khurrana's opening-day recordThe film began its theatrical run with Rs 4.10 crore in India net collections. This placed it eighth among Ayushmann Khurrana's biggest opening-day performers, leaving it outside his career top five. His 2025 release 'Thamma' remains ahead, having collected Rs 24 crore net in India on its opening day.Directed by Aakash Kaushik, 'Udta Teer' has Ayushmann Khurrana playing Vikrant, also known as Bilal Ahmed. Sara Ali Khan portrays Yamini.
